source-a.source_api_disposition: Exact sealed sources expose the required public models/signatures; original native builds/tests succeeded. Structural source reviews are exact-source-SHA and log bound. No compilation/signature issue found.

observed_final_behavior.description: No confirmed scored product defect in scoped FINAL evidence. iOS caller replacement has expected Harbor sketch focus, seeded queue status, summary and disabled primary. H1 preserves optional sketch=pending in successfully dispatched confirmation and accepts it when required objects are complete. Visual state review shows readable wrapping, complete notes and specified disabled palette appearance. These are scoped observations, not proof of all brief details or Android acceptance.
